name: @dialpad/dialtone-migration-helper
description: Chrome extension for reviewing the Dialtone next migration: swap a live page between next and stable Dialtone (CSS, tokens, and component DOM structure), inspect token diffs on hover.

scripts.zip: rm -f dialtone-migration-helper-*.zip && zip -r "dialtone-migration-helper-$(node -p 'require("./manifest.json").version').zip" manifest.json background.js content.js token-renames.js structure.js rules.js popup.html popup.js popup.css docs/analysis && echo 'Share the zip — testers unzip and Load Unpacked in chrome://extensions'
